scope: Jordan medical discovery — University of Jordan School of Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: The University of Jordan's current bachelor's programme-and-fee document lists Doctor of Medicine (MD) as a 256-credit-hour programme with a 90 minimum average and an international rate of USD 500 per credit hour.
An official 2023 MD study-plan document identifies the Doctor of Medicine degree and 256 credit hours.
The School's published MD regulations contain historical ACCM accreditation information explicitly limited to 31 May 2016–31 May 2022.

holdReasons: The available ACCM statement expired in 2022; no independent current programme recognition/accreditation evidence was established for the necessary recognition badges.
The published fee is a per-credit international rate, but a current route-specific fee, admissions, clinical-training, accommodation and international-support packet was not completed.
Older MD plan material conflicts with current 256-hour information and must not be used to infer a current curriculum or duration.
nextAction: Obtain current independent programme recognition/accreditation, admissions calendar and requirements, curriculum duration/clinical placement evidence, and current international student support before packaging.
